description: This PHP source file defines the TLSmarty class, a wrapper for the Smarty templating engine used in the TestLink project. It includes functions for status translation, template inclusion guards, and image set management, along with configuration and initialization code for the templating system.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: A wrapper class extending Smarty for TestLink, managing template directories, configuration, images, and plugin registration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TLSmarty object, setting template directories, configuration, images, and registering Smarty plugins and filters.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Returns the set of images used in the templates.

methods.name: getImageSet
methods.description: Static method that constructs and returns an array of image paths used in the interface.
